purpose: Two first-class captures of one inherited instance method create equivalent fresh private-static Generators; both callable closures and maker retire before the selected body and close finally.
source:
<?php
class Mid80A {
    private static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Mid80A'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf80A'), '|';
        try {
            yield 80;
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|';
        }
    }
    public function make() {
        echo 'MAKE|';
        return self::body();
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Leaf80A extends Mid80A {
    public static function body() { echo 'BAD-BODY|'; yield 0; }
}
$maker = new Leaf80A();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$first = $maker->make(...);
$second = $maker->make(...);
$weakFirst = WeakReference::create($first);
$weakSecond = WeakReference::create($second);
$g = $first();
$other = $second();
unset($first, $second, $maker);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weakFirst->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakSecond->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakMaker->get() === null), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 80), '|';
unset($g);
echo 'AFTER|', (int) ($other instanceof Generator), '|';
unset($other, $weakMaker, $weakFirst, $weakSecond);
echo 'E';

purpose: A captured inherited instance factory calls parent protected nonstatic Generator; the callable retires but the real saved frame keeps the receiver through close finally.
source:
<?php
class Base80B {
    protected function body() {
        global $weakMaker;
        echo 'BODY|', (int) ($this === $weakMaker->get()), '|';
        try {
            yield 80;
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', (int) ($this === $weakMaker->get()), '|';
        }
    }
}
class Mid80B extends Base80B {
    public function make() {
        echo 'MAKE|';
        return parent::body();
    }
}
class Leaf80B extends Mid80B {
    public function body() { echo 'BAD-BODY|'; yield 0; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
$maker = new Leaf80B();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$factory = Closure::fromCallable([$maker, 'make']);
$weakFactory = WeakReference::create($factory);
$g = $factory();
unset($factory, $maker);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weakFactory->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakMaker->get() instanceof Leaf80B), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 80), '|';
unset($g);
echo 'AFTER|', (int) ($weakMaker->get() === null), '|';
unset($weakFactory, $weakMaker);
echo 'E';

purpose: A captured inherited static factory forwards its real Leaf called scope to the Leaf protected override after the callable retires.
source:
<?php
class Mid80C {
    public static function make() {
        echo 'MAKE|';
        return static::body();
    }
    protected static function body() { echo 'BAD-MID|'; yield 0; }
}
class Leaf80C extends Mid80C {
    protected static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Leaf80C'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf80C'), '|';
        yield 80;
        return 81;
    }
}
$factory = Closure::fromCallable([Leaf80C::class, 'make']);
$weakFactory = WeakReference::create($factory);
$g = $factory();
unset($factory);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weakFactory->get() === null), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 80), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'RETURN|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 81), '|';
unset($g, $weakFactory);
echo 'E';

purpose: A captured private Mid fromCallable method on Host selects its own private static Generator body, then the callable and Host retire. Fresh BYREF SEND keeps Delivered temporarily, supplied Fiber abort releases it, while the reference cache owns Item until Generator drop.
source:
<?php
class Item80 { function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
class Delivered80 {
    function __construct() { global $wd; $wd = WeakReference::create($this); }
    function __destruct() { echo 'DELIVERED|'; }
}
class Mid80 {
    public function capture() { return Closure::fromCallable([$this, 'make']); }
    private function make(&$item) {
        global $wh;
        echo 'MAKE|', __CLASS__ === 'Mid80', '|', static::class === 'Host80', '|', $this === $wh->get(), '|';
        return Mid80::body($item);
    }
    private static function &body(&$item) {
        global $wp, $wd;
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Mid80', '|', static::class === 'Mid80', '|';
        try {
            Fiber::suspend('fresh80');
            $received = yield $item;
            echo 'RECEIVE|', $received === $wd->get(), '|';
            Fiber::suspend('cached80');
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', $wp->get() instanceof Item80, '|', $wd->get() instanceof Delivered80, '|';
        }
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'HOST|'; }
}
class Host80 extends Mid80 {
    public function make(&$item) { echo 'BAD|'; return []; }
}
function Run80() { global $g; echo 'CALL|'; $g->send(new Delivered80()); echo 'BAD|'; }
$item = new Item80(); $old =& $item; $wp = WeakReference::create($item);
$host = new Host80(); $wh = WeakReference::create($host);
$factory = $host->capture(); $wf = WeakReference::create($factory);
$g = $factory($item);
unset($factory, $host, $item); $item = 9;
echo 'FRESH|', $wf->get() === null, '|', $wh->get() === null, '|', $wp->get() instanceof Item80, '|';
$f = new Fiber('Run80'); $stop = new Exception('stop80');
echo 'START|'; $first = $f->start();
echo 'FRESH-ARG|', $first === 'fresh80', '|', $wd->get() instanceof Delivered80, '|';
echo 'RESUME|'; $second = $f->resume('go80'); unset($old);
echo 'CACHED|', $second === 'cached80', '|', $g->current() === $wp->get(), '|', $item === 9, '|', $wd->get() instanceof Delivered80, '|';
echo 'ABORT|';
try { $f->throw($stop); }
catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo 'OUT|', $e === $stop, '|', $e->getPrevious() === null, '|', $f->isTerminated(), '|', $wd->get() === null, '|', $wp->get() instanceof Item80, '|';
}
echo 'CLOSED|', $g->current() === null, '|', $wp->get() instanceof Item80, '|';
unset($g, $f, $stop, $e);
echo 'DROP|', $wp->get() === null, '|E';
